grader.method: Read all 15 answers and citations, compared each with eval/cases/model-comparison-v1.jsonl and local source material, checked quote/span/hash/provenance, exact citation-to-retrieved-evidence linkage, abstention/security, latency and trace. No provider calls and no runtime/database/source-file mutation.

summary.model_exercise: NOT_OBSERVABLE_AS_A_MODEL_COMPARISON; generation_trace.outcome=skipped for every successful case in all three artifacts, provider usage is absent for all 15 cases, and successful answer hashes are identical across models for all five questions

winner.quality: NO_VALID_MODEL_WINNER; the model was not exercised for successful answers, and all models share the same retrieval/guardrail answer pattern
winner.operational_latency: 4o-mini has the lowest all-case median (12,438.66 ms); nano has the lowest reported p95 (21,582.50 ms) and wall time (62,889.41 ms). Differences are not statistically meaningful from one five-case run.
winner.reliability: All three rerun artifacts complete 5/5; the prior Luna transient error is retained only as historical context and is not included in this score

summary.common_failure_pattern: Retrieval/guardrail emits raw or stale passages: current five-year rule is recoverable, provincial and emergency rules are incomplete raw bullets, student returns a 1998 local rule for a 2026 question, and cosmetic returns an unrelated 1998 payment rule instead of the Article 23(6) exclusion.
